verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these three kinds of barrenness.

verses.pali: Rāgo khilo, doso khilo, moho khilo—

verses.english: These are the three kinds of barrenness.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇannaṁ khilānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
verses.english: The noble eightfold path should be developed for the direct knowledge, complete understanding, finishing, and giving up of these three kinds of barrenness.”
